title: Romesco jus (served with lamb rack)
ingredients: Of course, I'd be happy to teach you more about romesco sauce and how to make it!
Here is a basic recipe for romesco sauce:
2 red bell peppers, roasted and peeled
instructions: Cut the red bell peppers in half, remove the stem and seeds, and place them on a baking sheet cut-side down.
Roast the peppers in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the skin is charred and blistered.
Remove the peppers from the oven and place them in a bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the peppers cool for 10-15 minutes.
Once the peppers are cool, remove the skin and discard it.
In a food processor or blender, combine the roasted red peppers, blanched almonds, breadcrumbs, garlic, and sherry vinegar.
Process the mixture until it is smooth and well combined.
Slowly drizzle in the olive oil while the blender or food processor is running, and continue to process the mixture until it is thick and creamy.
Season the romesco sauce with salt and pepper to taste.

And to turn the sauce into romesco jus, simply add chicken or vegetable broth to the sauce and blend it together until it reaches your desired consistency. You can adjust the amount of broth to create a thinner or thicker jus, depending on your preference. The jus can be heated in a saucepan on the stove or in the microwave, and served warm over meat, fish, or vegetables.
